verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a substantial first-party programmatic surface: a local REST API bundled with the desktop app, a versioned OpenAPI spec with v2 objects exposed as editable JSON documents, a headless CLI server, an official MCP server, and chat endpoints. It also supports reading, searching and modifying Objects, plus a gRPC API. No evidence says the API reaches parity with the UI, and many UI features (web publishing, collaboration/sharing, templates, queries/views, graph, widgets, import/export) have no documented API counterpart. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity claim or coverage map, documented API support for publishing, sharing, templates, views and import/export, and independent hands-on confirmation of API breadth.
